activation_condition: P13b fails any locked Fold-0 gate or its epoch-15 futility rule.
scientific_question: Can the paper-grounded WavLM L-adapter recipe learn speaker-discriminative complementary features on the competition data while updating only small layer adapters and transformer LayerNorms?

research_anchor.paper: Parameter Efficient Transfer Learning for Various Speech Processing Tasks

locked_asv_choices.adapter: Linear(768,512) + ReLU + LayerNorm per transformer layer

locked_change_vs_p13b.single_scientific_change: Replace the fully frozen weighted sum with twelve trainable 768-to-512 L-adapters, trainable softmax layer weights, and trainable WavLM transformer LayerNorms following the cited ASV recipe.

fold0_gate.passing_action: Permit complementary error analysis only; no automatic later fold or submission.
fold0_gate.failing_action: Close WavLM L-adapter and return to the CAM++ error-forensics hypothesis queue.

operational_contract.batch_selection_rule: Choose the highest measured files-per-second candidate that is OOM-free and remains below 90 percent of total VRAM; ties choose the smaller batch.
immediate_stop: OOM after one measured batch correction
trainable WavLM scope differs from the locked LayerNorm-only contract
layer adapter or layer weight counts differ from the locked contract
